mapper.sql:
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY RBRC.REG_DTTM DESC) AS "LINE_NO" , RBRC.RUBRIC_ID , RBRC.USER_ID , USR.USERNM AS "PROFNM" , RBRC.RUBRIC_TTL , RBRC.RUBRIC_QSTN_CNT , RBRC.RUBRIC_TYCD , RGTR.USERNM AS "RGTRNM" , RBRC.REG_DTTM , RBRC.USEYN FROM TB_LMS_RUBRIC RBRC JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON RBRC.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER RGTR ON RBRC.RGTR_ID = RGTR.USER_ID WHERE RBRC.USER_ID = #{userId} AND RBRC.UP_RUBRIC_ID IS NULL /* 과제 등 타 화면에서 등록된 루브릭 제외 */ AND RBRC.RUBRIC_TYCD = 'PROF' AND RBRC.DELYN = 'N'
AND RBRC.RUBRIC_TTL LIKE '%' || #{rubricTtl} || '%'
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : RubricDAO.listRubricPaging 설명 : 루브릭 목록 페이징 */
/* SQL ID : RubricDAO.countRubric 설명 : 루브릭 목록 카운트 */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM () Z

/* SQL ID : RubricDAO.selectRubricRegistInfo 설명 : 루브릭 등록정보 조회 */ SELECT ORG.ORGNM , USR.USERNM , RBRC.RUBRIC_TTL , RBRC.RUBRIC_TYCD FROM TB_LMS_RUBRIC RBRC JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON RBRC.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON RBRC.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID WHERE RBRC.RUBRIC_ID = #{rubricId}

/* SQL ID : RubricDAO.selectRegisterInfo 설명 : 등록자 정보 조회 */ SELECT ORG.ORGNM , USR.USERNM , NULL AS RUBRIC_TTL FROM TB_LMS_USER USR JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON USR.DEPT_ID = DEPT.DEPT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON DEPT.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID WHERE USR.USER_ID = #{userId}

/* SQL ID : RubricDAO.listRubricInfo 설명 : 루브릭 문항정보 목록 조회 */ SELECT /* 문항 */ QSTN.RUBRIC_QSTN_ID , QSTN.RUBRIC_QSTN_TTL , QSTN.EVLRT , QSTN.RUBRIC_EVL_TYCD /* 문항 평가 */ , VWITM.RUBRIC_VWITM_ID , VWITM.RUBRIC_VWITM_TTL , VWITM.RUBRIC_VWITM_PNT , VWITM.RUBRIC_VWITM_SEQNO FROM TB_LMS_RUBRIC_QSTN QSTN /* 문항 평가 */ JOIN TB_LMS_RUBRIC_VWITM VWITM ON QSTN.RUBRIC_QSTN_ID = VWITM.RUBRIC_QSTN_ID WHERE QSTN.RUBRIC_ID = #{rubricId} ORDER BY QSTN.RUBRIC_QSTN_SEQNO , VWITM.RUBRIC_VWITM_SEQNO ASC

/* SQL ID : RubricDAO.importRubricList 설명 : 루브릭 가져오기 목록 (루브릭 관리자 등록 + 본인 등록 조회) */ SELECT RBRC.RUBRIC_ID , RBRC.USER_ID , USR.USERNM AS PROFNM , RBRC.RUBRIC_TTL , RBRC.RUBRIC_QSTN_CNT , RBRC.RUBRIC_TYCD , RGTR.USERNM AS RGTRNM , RBRC.REG_DTTM , RBRC.USEYN FROM TB_LMS_RUBRIC RBRC JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON RBRC.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER RGTR ON RBRC.RGTR_ID = RGTR.USER_ID WHERE RBRC.RUBRIC_TYCD IN ('ORG', 'PROF') AND ( (RBRC.RUBRIC_TYCD = 'ORG' AND RBRC.ORG_ID = #{orgId}) OR (RBRC.RUBRIC_TYCD = 'PROF' AND RBRC.USER_ID = #{userId}) ) AND RBRC.DELYN = 'N' AND RBRC.USEYN = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE RBRC.RUBRIC_TYCD WHEN 'ORG' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , RBRC.REG_DTTM DESC
mapper.update: /* SQL ID : RubricDAO.rubricDelete 설명 : 루브릭 삭제 */ UPDATE TB_LMS_RUBRIC SET DELYN = 'Y' , MDFR_ID = #{mdfrId} , MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHERE RUBRIC_ID = #{rubricId}
mapper.delete: /* SQL ID : RubricDAO.rubricQstnDelete 설명 : 루브릭 문항 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_LMS_RUBRIC_QSTN WHERE RUBRIC_ID = #{rubricId}
/* SQL ID : RubricDAO.rubricVwitmDelete 설명 : 루브릭 보기항목 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_LMS_RUBRIC_VWITM WHERE RUBRIC_QSTN_ID IN (SELECT RUBRIC_QSTN_ID FROM TB_LMS_RUBRIC_QSTN WHERE RUBRIC_ID = #{rubricId} )
